title: Side Projects — Small Tools David Holt Built for Himself
summary: Small tools David Holt built between other work, usually because a normal day handed him a specific annoyance and the fastest fix was to write a tool for it. None of these are products or downloads — this page is a set of write-ups, not source code.

projects.name: Instrument Builder
projects.summary: A freeform, drawing-based synthesizer for designing custom instruments: sketch the shape of a sound directly with control over volume, pitch, filter, pan, and spectrum, layer sketched sounds with real audio samples, and play the result back over MIDI.

projects.name: Zoom Volume Regulator
projects.summary: A background utility that applies automatic gain control during calls, continuously measuring speech level and smoothing it out in real time, with logging of how it adjusted over a call.

projects.name: GasBuddy Watcher
projects.summary: A system-tray watcher that checks nearby gas prices on a schedule, logs the history, and builds an HTML dashboard so price trends and drops are easy to spot.

projects.name: Custom Typing Test
projects.summary: A drill purpose-built to train the number row at the top of the keyboard, tracking per-digit accuracy and hesitation time before each keystroke, rolling every session into a trends dashboard.

projects.name: YNAB Insights
projects.summary: A forecasting layer on top of YNAB: statistical detection of recurring income/expenses, forward-looking forecasts, a credit-card autopay estimator, and a monthly net worth snapshot pushed to Compass.

projects.name: Animation AI
projects.summary: A local pipeline that transcribes audio, lets you mark scene breaks and notes in a director panel, has an AI step turn that into a storyboard, and renders the storyboard into an animated scene, with every version auto-saved.

author: David Holt
